title: Oak River Bridge to close nightly for repairs starting Monday
body: The Oak River Bridge on Route 9 will close to all traffic from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly for deck repairs, the county transportation department said.

title: Maple Falls council approves Elm Street rezoning 5-2
body: The City Council voted 5-2 to rezone six blocks along Elm Street to mixed use.

title: Central bank raises interest rates by a quarter point
body: The national central bank raised its benchmark rate by 0.25 percentage points on Wednesday, citing persistent inflation.

title: 10 cozy sweaters for fall
body: Our editors picked the best knitwear of the season, from budget to luxury.

title: Brush fire near Riverton grows to 300 acres
body: A brush fire east of Riverton has burned about 300 acres; a Level 2 evacuation notice was issued for Ridge Road.

title: Cedar County schools face $3.2 million shortfall
body: The county school district projects a budget shortfall driven by declining enrollment.

title: Leaders sign climate accord at summit
body: Representatives of 40 countries signed an agreement to cut methane emissions by 30 percent by 2035.

title: Local high school wins state basketball title
body: Maple Falls High beat Riverton 61-58 in the state championship game Saturday.
